title: Generic RP2040 (Raspberry Pi Pico style, USB)
description: Any RP2040 board with the standard second-stage flash settings, USB serial, no bootloader. Same build as the SKR Pico preset but without board-specific pin assumptions (Klipper pins are chosen in the printer config).
notes: Compile-only: built in a sandbox with Klipper v0.13.0; never flashed or run on this board by the author.
BOOTSEL: hold the boot button while plugging USB in; a drive named RPI-RP2 appears.
UNVERIFIED: flash chip type of your board. Boards that do not use W25Q080-compatible flash may need the GENERIC_03H option via Menuconfig.
